items.title: Who is holding Jensen Huang accountable? It sure looks like nobody
items.summary: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi digs into day two of Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Including a Financial Times report that interim CEO Colette Kress was left out of the talks to bring Huang back, a Wall Street Journal report that Huang disclosed more affairs to the board than previously known, why Brian says Nvidia is effectively a "board of one," and what history says about returning founders from Steve Jobs and Howard Schultz to Kevin Plank.

items.title: Have robotaxis hit a tipping point? Wall Street and experts are split.
items.summary: Robotaxis are seemingly everywhere, especially if you live in a major city, but the robotaxi tipping point may be upon us.

items.title: Your $300,000 in XLC Holds $130,206 in Just Meta and Alphabet
items.summary: A fund labeled communication services sounds like a broad bet on telecom, media, and entertainment. The latest SEC filing shows something far narrower, and one company hides in plain sight by appearing on the holdings list twice.

items.title: 5 Sleeper Blue-Chip Stock Picks for Steady Long-Term Gains

items.title: Stephanie Link Says Marvell Could Earn $30 a Share by 2031. Is She Right?
items.summary: Marvell shares have lost 42% in a month, yet one CNBC strategist keeps buying and sees earnings power far beyond Wall Street's models. What would have to go right for that bet to pay off, and what could break it?

items.title: Billionaire Charlie Munger’s Protege Li Lu: Himalaya Capital Has 45% of Its $3.78 Billion Portfolio in Alphabet
items.summary: Li Lu built his reputation on Munger-style concentration, and his latest filing shows how far he will push it. Behind one oversized bet sits a cash-burning spending spree that could test even a patient value investor.

items.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Is One of the Safest Ways to Own AI

I believe that gives it considerable room to fund its next stage of growth. CEO Satya Nadella recently remarked, “We think of Copilot as the new OS for work.” I like that ambition, but I also like the existing business behind it.
